files.legend.sop:
@legend.kids.tasks core.legend
    namespace=kids.tasks
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Items on personal lists. The lists themselves live in the session state; every change is mirrored as an entry wire."

@kids.tasks.entry core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="One item on a named list and whether it is still to do, done or removed. Written by the list operations, one wire per item."
    example="milk on the shopping list"
    negative="A banana is yellow."

@kids.tasks.entry.list core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which list is the item on?"

@kids.tasks.entry.text core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is the item?"

@kids.tasks.entry.progress core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Is it todo, done or removed?"

@kids.tasks.entry.batch core.key
    value=number
    ask="Which request put the item on the list?"

@kids.tasks.entry.assumed core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Was the list assumed because the user did not name it?"
